messages:
maria (growth): idea: for the benchmark hero let's show a small waterfall cost-per-interaction, plus latency bands instead of single p50/p95 numbers. want a single row hero that reads in social cards. who can prototype visuals + copy?
tejas (marketing): neat. waterfall helps non-technical buyers see where savings come from (batching, KV cache, quant). i'll sketch the copy and experiment plan.
olivia (design): i'll do a compact hero: left = latency band area chart (shaded p10-p90 by token length), center = waterfall (hosted baseline -> batching -> quant -> dedicated delta), right = skinny throughput sparkline for mobile. will need sample numbers.
samir (pm): i'll export a trimmed CSV: columns seq_len,stage,cost_delta_ms,cost_delta_usd. sample rows I recommend for layout: 
```
seq_len,stage,cost_delta_usd,cost_delta_ms
512,baseline,0.020,230
512,batching,-0.007, -60
512,quantization,-0.008, +10
512,dedicated,-0.004, -40
```
use as placeholder.
joel (analytics): quick sanity check: hosted baseline cost ~0.020/1k; batching and quant reduce unit cost but can add a slight tail latency for very short requests. avoid bold absolute multipliers in hero.
nina (content): CTA variants: A) "Start free" (trial funnel) B) "Estimate savings" (calculator + demo). two short headers: 1) "See predictable inference costs" 2) "Latency-first, cost-savvy serving." I'll draft micro-copy for the waterfall labels.
maria (growth): routing rule proposal: trial signups -> collect estimated monthly tokens. route to AE if est tokens >75k OR avg daily requests >500. also tag mid-tier accounts for nurture.
tejas (marketing): A/B test plan: hero CTA A vs B, measure CTR -> signup -> token churn over 14 days. set up dashboard with Joel.
olivia (design): will deliver desktop hero + responsive stack by Thu. need the CSV from Samir and final hero header by Wed noon.
samir (pm): CSV link: /bench/2026-03/waterfall-hero.csv. added cold/warm cache rows as separate stages.
joel (analytics): i'll instrument the experiment, create segments (organic vs paid), and a conversion funnel that includes token volume within first 7 days.
maria (growth): timeline and owners: design Olivia, copy Nina, data Samir, analytics Joel, experiment Tejas, launch Maria. quick sync Mon 15m to sign off creative.
nina (content): dropping micro-copy drafts in the doc now. keeping tone concise + slightly technical. :sparkles:
